Source: Somalia FMOH e-IDSR Weekly Epidemiological Bulletin series (ReliefWeb, 2022-2024)
Description: NOT MINED BY AGENT 1 - REGISTERED AS A LEAD. The Somalia Federal Ministry of Health e-IDSR Weekly Epidemiological Bulletin is published on ReliefWeb as a weekly series; 66 issues are indexed, spanning epi-week 12 of 2022 to epi-week 47 of 2024, each with weekly AWD/suspected-cholera cases and deaths at region and district level. None of the indexed years falls in an Agent 1 target gap (2022-2024 are already covered at annual level), and the series stops in late 2024, so it cannot close the 2026 recency gap either. It is however the single richest untapped source for weekly and sub-national granularity in 2022-2024 and should be worked by the geographic-expansion and cross-reference agents.
